summary: Tested new Comparison/Snapshot feature end-to-end: 4 backend endpoints (POST/GET/GET/DELETE) validated via 8 pytest cases (100% pass) and full UI flow (nav → 3 tabs → take snapshot → history row appears live → 2nd snapshot → compare-grid/summary shows current+previous with deltas → per-period isolation → delete). All 13 KPI keys returned correctly. Snapshots cleaned up after testing.

minor.issue: Invalid period values (e.g. 'yearly') are stored as-is in DB even though KPI computation coerces to 'weekly' internally. Consider rejecting with 400 for period not in weekly|monthly|quarterly to avoid orphaned records.

ui_bugs.issue: IRIS chat panel auto-opens on page load and visually overlays the right side of the Snapshot History table, covering the delete (trash) icon of the top-most row. Click still succeeds programmatically via force-click, but real users cannot click that delete icon without first closing IRIS. Recommend IRIS default to collapsed on the Comparison page, or ensure history table right-padding accounts for IRIS width.

issues: Baseline snapshot cards show '— 0 (0%)' badge which reads ambiguous; consider explicit 'baseline' badge as described in the spec (currently only appears when no previous exists at page level).

action_items: MEDIUM: Auto-collapse IRIS on Comparison page OR add right-padding to snapshot history so delete button on row 0 isn't obscured.
LOW: Validate `period` param on POST /api/comparison/snapshot (reject non weekly|monthly|quarterly with 400).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _snapshot_kpis (~L867): heavy call chain (executive+xsoar+rules+ti+overlay) every snapshot; acceptable at manual cadence but consider timing budget if scheduled.

compare_snapshots (L922): only compares the 2 latest snapshots regardless of period semantics; label 'weekly comparison' but if user takes two snapshots minutes apart, delta reflects that. This is documented behaviour but worth surfacing in the UI copy.
delete endpoint has no ownership/tenant check — any authenticated user can delete any snapshot by id.
seed_data_creation: None. All snapshots created during test were deleted at end (verified via API list returning 0 for weekly/monthly/quarterly). Tenant 'all' rules/xsoar/logval data left intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Comparison feature verified working. Only outstanding UX issue: IRIS panel overlaps row-0 delete icon on the Comparison page. Backend delete has no auth ownership check (any admin can delete any snapshot) — flag if multi-tenant scoping becomes a requirement.
